candidates.label: Quran as ahsan al-qasas establishing prophetic storytelling paradigm
candidates.definition: In 12:3: We relate to you the best of narratives through Our revelation of this Quran.

evidence.excerpt: نَحۡنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡقَصَصِ بِمَآ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ وَإِن كُنتَ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَمِنَ ٱلۡغَٰفِلِينَ

candidates.label: Cosmic dream foreshadowing future familial authority
candidates.definition: In 12:4: Yusuf saw eleven stars and sun and moon prostrating to him.

evidence.excerpt: إِذۡ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّي رَأَيۡتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوۡكَبٗا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ رَأَيۡتُهُمۡ لِي سَٰجِدِينَ

candidates.label: Paternal warning against sibling jealousy and shaytan exploitation
candidates.definition: In 12:5: Do not relate your vision to your brothers lest they devise a plan against you — shaytan is an open enemy.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ لَا تَقۡصُصۡ رُءۡيَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ إِخۡوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُواْ لَكَ كَيۡدًاۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ

candidates.label: Fratricidal conspiracy driven by perceived paternal favoritism
candidates.definition: In 12:8-9: Brothers say Yusuf and his brother more beloved to father than us though we are stronger group — kill Yusuf or exile him.

evidence.excerpt: إِذۡ قَالُواْ لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحۡنُ عُصۡبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ

candidates.label: Well-as-transition motif from family to foreign providence
candidates.definition: In 12:10: Cast him into bottom of well — some travelers will pick him up. Well functions as liminal space between abandonment and divine rescue.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ لَا تَقۡتُلُواْ يُوسُفَ وَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي غَيَٰبَتِ ٱلۡجُبِّ يَلۡتَقِطۡهُ بَعۡضُ ٱلسَّيَّارَةِ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ

candidates.label: Divine providence through commercial transaction
candidates.definition: In 12:19-20: Caravan water-scout finds Yusuf at well; sold for few dirhams counted out — divine plan operating through mundane commerce.

evidence.excerpt: وَجَآءَتۡ سَيَّارَةٞ فَأَرۡسَلُواْ وَارِدَهُمۡ فَأَدۡلَىٰ دَلۡوَهُۥۖ قَالَ يَٰبُشۡرَىٰ هَٰذَا غُلَٰمٞۚ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَٰعَةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُونَ

candidates.label: Sexual temptation resisted through isti'adha (divine refuge)
candidates.definition: In 12:23: She said come to me; he said ma'adh Allah — my lord has made my residence good. Seeking refuge in Allah from sin.

evidence.excerpt: وَرَٰوَدَتۡهُ ٱلَّتِي هُوَ فِي بَيۡتِهَا عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦ وَغَلَّقَتِ ٱلۡأَبۡوَٰبَ وَقَالَتۡ هَيۡتَ لَكَۚ قَالَ مَعَاذَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَحۡسَنَ مَثۡوَايَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ

candidates.label: Garment-tearing as forensic evidence of innocence
candidates.definition: In 12:25-28: Garment torn from behind proves Yusuf fled rather than pursued; witness from her family testifies to directional evidence.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱسۡتَبَقَا ٱلۡبَابَ وَقَدَّتۡ قَمِيصَهُۥ مِن دُبُرٖ وَأَلۡفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا ٱلۡبَابِۚ قَالَتۡ مَا جَزَآءُ مَنۡ أَرَادَ بِأَهۡلِكَ سُوٓءًا إِلَّآ أَن يُسۡجَنَ أَوۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ

candidates.label: Collective female recognition of Yusuf's extraordinary nature
candidates.definition: In 12:31: Women of city invited, given knives, amazed at Yusuf's beauty cutting their hands saying hash lil-lah this is no human but noble angel.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتۡ بِمَكۡرِهِنَّ أَرۡسَلَتۡ إِلَيۡهِنَّ وَأَعۡتَدَتۡ لَهُنَّ مُتَّكَـٔٗا وَءَاتَتۡ كُلَّ وَٰحِدَةٖ مِّنۡهُنَّ سِكِّينٗا وَقَالَتِ ٱخۡرُجۡ عَلَيۡهِنَّۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَيۡنَهُۥٓ أَكۡبَرۡنَهُۥ وَقَطَّعۡنَ أَيۡدِيَهُنَّ وَقُلۡنَ حَٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا هَٰذَا بَشَرًا إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا مَلَكٞ كَرِيمٞ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Beauty as sign of prophetic distinction.

candidates.label: Voluntary imprisonment chosen over moral compromise
candidates.definition: In 12:33: Yusuf says Lord prison is dearer to me than what they invite me to — choosing confinement over sin.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱلسِّجۡنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَيۡهِۖ وَإِلَّا تَصۡرِفۡ عَنِّي كَيۡدَهُنَّ أَصۡبُ إِلَيۡهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ

candidates.label: Dream interpretation preceded by tawheed instruction
candidates.definition: In 12:37-40: Before interpreting dreams Yusuf teaches monotheism rejecting multiple lords affirming judgment belongs to Allah alone.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ لَا يَأۡتِيكُمَا طَعَامٞ تُرۡزَقَانِهِۦٓ إِلَّا نَبَّأۡتُكُمَا بِتَأۡوِيلِهِۦ قَبۡلَ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمَاۚ ذَٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِي رَبِّيٓۚ إِنِّي تَرَكۡتُ مِلَّةَ قَوۡمٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ

candidates.label: Dual prisoner dreams demonstrating interpretive accuracy
candidates.definition: In 12:36-41: Wine-presser will serve king again; baker will be crucified and birds eat from head — both fulfilled exactly.

evidence.excerpt: وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ ٱلسِّجۡنَ فَتَيَانِۖ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَآ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰنِيٓ أَعۡصِرُ خَمۡرٗاۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡأٓخَرُ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰنِيٓ أَحۡمِلُ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِي خُبۡزٗا تَأۡكُلُ ٱلطَّيۡرُ مِنۡهُۖ نَبِّئۡنَا بِتَأۡوِيلِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّا نَرَىٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

candidates.label: Royal dream crisis enabling emergence from obscurity
candidates.definition: In 12:43-49: King dreams seven fat cows eaten by seven lean seven green ears dry; nobles confused; released prisoner remembers Yusuf.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلِكُ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ سَبۡعَ بَقَرَٰتٖ سِمَانٖ يَأۡكُلُهُنَّ سَبۡعٌ عِجَافٞ وَسَبۡعَ سُنۢبُلَٰتٍ خُضۡرٖ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَٰتٖۖ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَأُ أَفۡتُونِي فِي رُءۡيَٰيَ إِن كُنتُمۡ لِلرُّءۡيَا تَعۡبُرُونَ

candidates.label: Delayed remembrance as divine timing mechanism
candidates.definition: In 12:42: Shaytan made him forget mentioning Yusuf to his lord — so Yusuf remained in prison several more years.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ لِلَّذِي ظَنَّ أَنَّهُۥ نَاجٖ مِّنۡهُمَا ٱذۡكُرۡنِي عِندَ رَبِّكَ فَأَنسَىٰهُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ ذِكۡرَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِي ٱلسِّجۡنِ بِضۡعَ سِنِينَ

candidates.label: Conditional release requiring prior public exoneration
candidates.definition: In 12:50-51: King says bring him; Yusuf says return to your lord ask about women who cut hands — refuses freedom without cleared name.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱئۡتُونِي بِهِۦۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُ ٱلرَّسُولُ قَالَ ٱرۡجِعۡ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَسۡـَٔلۡهُ مَا بَالُ ٱلنِّسۡوَةِ ٱلَّـٰتِي قَطَّعۡنَ أَيۡدِيَهُنَّۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي بِكَيۡدِهِنَّ عَلِيمٞ

candidates.label: Institutional appointment based on proven trustworthiness and knowledge
candidates.definition: In 12:55: Yusuf says appoint me over storehouses inni hafizun aleem — I am a knowing guardian.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي عَلَىٰ خَزَآئِنِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ إِنِّي حَفِيظٌ عَلِيمٞ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Hifz and ilm as qualification criteria.

candidates.label: Forensic testimony establishing innocence through garment direction
candidates.definition: In 12:26-28: Witness from her family testifies if torn from front she truthful if from behind he truthful — garment torn from behind confirms Yusuf.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ هِيَ رَٰوَدَتۡنِي عَن نَّفۡسِيۚ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٞ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِهَآ إِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُۥ قُدَّ مِن قُبُلٖ فَصَدَقَتۡ وَهُوَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ

candidates.label: Public female confession confirming Yusuf's virtue
candidates.definition: In 12:51: King asks women what was your affair when you seduced Yusuf; they say hash lil-lah we know no evil of him.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ مَا خَطۡبُكُنَّ إِذۡ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦۚ قُلۡنَ حَٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِن سُوٓءٖۚ قَالَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡـَٰٔنَ حَصۡحَصَ ٱلۡحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

candidates.label: Aziz wife's admission of guilt completing exoneration
candidates.definition: In 12:51: Aziz's wife says now truth has become manifest — I seduced him and he is among the truthful.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ مَا خَطۡبُكُنَّ إِذۡ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦۚ قُلۡنَ حَٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِن سُوٓءٖۚ قَالَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡـَٰٔنَ حَصۡحَصَ ٱلۡحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

candidates.label: Seven-year agricultural cycle as divine sign and administrative framework
candidates.definition: In 12:47-49: Seven years of abundance followed by seven years of drought consuming stored grain except little preserved.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ تَزۡرَعُونَ سَبۡعَ سِنِينَ دَأَبٗا فَمَا حَصَدتُّمۡ فَذَرُوهُ فِي سُنۢبُلِهِۦٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا مِّمَّا تَأۡكُلُونَ

candidates.label: Administrative foresight in agricultural surplus management
candidates.definition: In 12:47-48: Yusuf instructs storing harvest during abundant years leaving only what is eaten preparing for seven drought years.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ تَزۡرَعُونَ سَبۡعَ سِنِينَ دَأَبٗا فَمَا حَصَدتُّمۡ فَذَرُوهُ فِي سُنۢبُلِهِۦٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا مِّمَّا تَأۡكُلُونَ

candidates.label: Unrecognized encounter enabling character testing
candidates.definition: In 12:58: Brothers came entered upon Yusuf he recognized them but they did not recognize him.

evidence.excerpt: وَجَآءَ إِخۡوَةُ يُوسُفَ فَدَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَعَرَفَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

candidates.label: Returned silver demonstrating integrity despite power
candidates.definition: In 12:62: Yusuf tells servants put their merchandise back in their sacks so they recognize it when returning to family.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ لِفِتۡيَٰنِهِ ٱجۡعَلُواْ بِضَٰعَتَهُمۡ فِي رِحَالِهِمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَعۡرِفُونَهَآ إِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Honesty when advantage could be taken.

candidates.label: Jacob's protective reluctance rooted in unresolved trauma
candidates.definition: In 12:64: Shall I entrust you with him as I entrusted you with his brother before? Allah is best guardian most merciful.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ هَلۡ ءَامَنُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا كَمَآ أَمِنتُكُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَخِيهِ مِن قَبۡلُ فَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرٌ حَٰفِظٗاۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّـٰحِمِينَ

candidates.label: Judah's guarantee marking moral growth from original conspirator
candidates.definition: In 12:66: Judah says I will not send him until you give firm covenant before Allah that you will bring him back.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ لَنۡ أُرۡسِلَهُۥ مَعَكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ تُؤۡتُونِ مَوۡثِقٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لَتَأۡتُنَّنِي بِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يُحَاطَ بِكُمۡۖ فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَوۡهُ مَوۡثِقَهُمۡ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٞ

candidates.label: Cup-test revealing brothers' willingness to sacrifice for sibling
candidates.definition: In 12:70-76: Cup placed in Benjamin's sack; brothers accused of theft; they respond whoever took it should be held — offering themselves.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمۡ جَعَلَ ٱلسِّقَايَةَ فِي رَحۡلِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ أَيَّتُهَا ٱلۡعِيرُ إِنَّكُمۡ لَسَٰرِقُونَ

candidates.label: Judah's eloquent plea demonstrating complete character reformation
candidates.definition: In 12:78-85: Judah appeals citing father's grief previous loss of Yusuf offers himself as substitute showing transformation from original plotter.

evidence.excerpt: قَالُواْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُۥٓ أَبٗا شَيۡخٗا كَبِيرٗا فَخُذۡ أَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُۥٓۖ إِنَّا نَرَىٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

candidates.label: Emotional disclosure as narrative climax
candidates.definition: In 12:90: I am Yusuf and this is my brother — Allah has truly favored us. Identity revelation resolves dramatic tension.

evidence.excerpt: قَالُوٓاْ أَءِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ يُوسُفُۖ قَالَ أَنَا۠ يُوسُفُ وَهَٰذَآ أَخِيۖ قَدۡ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَآۖ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصۡبِرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجۡرَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

candidates.label: Famine as catalyst for family reunion and dream fulfillment
candidates.definition: In 12:58: Famine drives brothers to Egypt where Yusuf governs — adversity becomes vehicle of divine plan.

evidence.excerpt: وَجَآءَ إِخۡوَةُ يُوسُفَ فَدَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَعَرَفَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

candidates.label: Simeon detention as leverage ensuring Benjamin's return
candidates.definition: In 12:69: Yusuf keeps one brother (Simeon) as hostage demanding younger brother as proof of honesty.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ أَخَاهُۖ قَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَنَا۠ أَخُوكَ فَلَا تَبۡتَئِسۡ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ

candidates.label: Unconditional forgiveness mirroring divine mercy
candidates.definition: In 12:92: No blame upon you today — may Allah forgive you and He is most merciful of the merciful.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ لَا تَثۡرِيبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ يَغۡفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّـٰحِمِينَ

candidates.label: Brothers' acknowledgment of Yusuf's election and their culpability
candidates.definition: In 12:91: By Allah certainly has Allah preferred you over us and we were indeed sinners.

evidence.excerpt: قَالُواْ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدۡ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَٰطِـِٔينَ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Admission of wrongdoing and divine preference.

candidates.label: Shirt-as-healing-motif connecting physical and relational restoration
candidates.definition: In 12:93-96: Go with this shirt cast it on father's face he will regain sight; shirt arrives scent detected before arrival sight restored.

evidence.excerpt: ٱذۡهَبُواْ بِقَمِيصِي هَٰذَا فَأَلۡقُوهُ عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِ أَبِي يَأۡتِ بَصِيرٗا وَأۡتُونِي بِأَهۡلِكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

existingTopicOverlap.note: Material object as vehicle of divine healing.

candidates.label: Throne-prostration fulfilling cosmic dream completing narrative arc
candidates.definition: In 12:100: He raised his parents upon the throne and they fell prostrate before him; he said this is the interpretation of my vision of old.

evidence.excerpt: وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيۡهِ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ وَخَرُّواْ لَهُۥ سُجَّدٗاۖ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ هَٰذَا تَأۡوِيلُ رُءۡيَٰيَ مِن قَبۡلُ قَدۡ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي حَقّٗاۖ وَقَدۡ أَحۡسَنَ بِيٓ إِذۡ أَخۡرَجَنِي مِنَ ٱلسِّجۡنِ وَجَآءَ بِكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡبَدۡوِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن نَّزَغَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَ إِخۡوَتِيٓۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٞ لِّمَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

candidates.label: Closing dua integrating personal gratitude with universal submission
candidates.definition: In 12:101: Lord You have given me sovereignty and taught interpretation — cause me to die as Muslim join me with righteous.

evidence.excerpt: ۞رَبِّ قَدۡ ءَاتَيۡتَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَعَلَّمۡتَنِي مِن تَأۡوِيلِ ٱلۡأَحَادِيثِۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّۦ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ تَوَفَّنِي مُسۡلِمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

candidates.label: Meta-narrative framing as Quranic confirmation of prior revelation
candidates.definition: In 12:111: This is not fabricated hadith but confirmation of what came before and detailed explanation of everything.
